question: Show sample count and average quality by wine type.
answer: wine_type: RED — Wine sample count: 1599; Average quality score: 5.636023. wine_type: WHITE — Wine sample count: 4898; Average quality score: 5.877909.

plan.message: Return sample count and average quality by wine type.

evidence.sql:
SELECT w.WINE_TYPE AS "wine_type", COUNT(*) AS "sample_count", AVG(w.QUALITY) AS "average_quality"
FROM DATAMIND_DEMO.UCI.WINE_QUALITY_WORKING_V1 w
GROUP BY w.WINE_TYPE
ORDER BY "wine_type" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 21
evidence.numeric_encoding: Fixed-point decimals are JSON strings to preserve precision.

warnings: Real historical Portuguese vinho verde measurements; do not generalize these results to all wines.
High-quality (score >= 7) is our analysis convention, not a binary label supplied by UCI.
No timestamps, brand, grape variety, selling price, customer or causal information is provided.
All original measurements are loaded; this API currently exposes four aggregate metrics and wine-type/quality grouping and filters.
Questions execute against a labelled working copy. The demo temporarily changes one score from 6 to 7, then restores it. Source table and downloaded archive are never edited by the demo.

metrics.sample_count: Number of source observations, not unique brands or people
metrics.average_quality: Arithmetic mean of sensory quality scores on a 0–10 scale
